title: Bulk approve refunds from the admin refunds page
description:
Support approves refunds one at a time and the queue backs up after every incident.

Acceptance criteria:
- Admins can select several pending refunds and approve them in one action (POST /admin/refunds/bulk)
- Only users with the refund:write permission can approve refunds, one at a time or in bulk
- Each approved refund posts exactly one ledger entry
- The refund multiselect shows only matching refunds while searching (design: hide unmatched items instead of greying them out, on every admin page that uses the shared multiselect)
